name: FUSE Workspace Bee Cave
subject: Office chair repair
body:
Hi FUSE Workspace Bee Cave team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. We repair and re-cover office chairs and lounge furniture, which usually costs much less than buying new. We can pick up and bring everything back.

If you send me photos of the pieces that need work, I'll get you prices.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Bigham & Associates
subject: Furniture repair for your units
body:
Hi Bigham & Associates team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. When a sofa or chair in one of your units gets damaged, we pick it up, repair it and bring it back, often faster than ordering a new one. We also do better pricing for multiple properties.

Who on your team would be the right person to talk to about this?

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com
